title: Before / after image wipe
description: Two images stacked on top of each other; drag the divider (or move the cursor) to wipe one over the other. A clip-path reveal with a draggable handle, a one-time intro sweep, and keyboard support. Perfect for day/night, edit/original, or retouch comparisons.
a11y: Focusable slider role with ArrowLeft/Right control; intro sweep is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion (dragging still works).
